pages.name: Klunnyk
pages.text: An old man in fiery clothes who lives by the lava lakes.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: The Klunnyk never attacks first. While you have not harmed him, he shields you from fire within 10 blocks: lava, magma and burning cannot hurt you.$(br2)Do not freeze his lake with $(item)Icy Touch$(): he will frown first, then grow angry.

pages.title: Wrath and gifts
pages.text: Whoever strikes a Klunnyk receives his heat: for 12 seconds it burns, hurts even a Spirit, but never kills, and wears down the durability of your gear without breaking it. Spirit Immunity does not remove it. Nearby Klunnyks grow angry too.$(br2)Give him coal or a blaze rod and he will thank you. A golden apple ends his anger.
